ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Jupiter

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.
